question: Looking for a bright citrus essential oil with high limonene and floral undertones. Customer wants a citrus blend with bright top notes for premium perfumery. Minimum 50kg yield needed for fall 2026 delivery.

nodes.label: A-INQ-010
nodes.description: Customer inquiry: citrus essential oil blend with high limonene, floral undertones, >=50kg yield for fall 2026

nodes.label: A-CMP-001 (limonene)
nodes.description: Monoterpene; CAS 138-86-3, PubChem CID 22311, ChEMBL CHEMBL17249; boiling point 176C; bright citrus odor

nodes.label: A-CMP-002 (linalool)
nodes.description: Monoterpenoid alcohol; CAS 78-70-6, PubChem CID 20963; floral lavender; boiling point 198C

nodes.label: A-CMP-003 (citral)
nodes.description: Monoterpene aldehyde mix; CAS 141-29-6 (geranial), 106-26-1 (neral); strong lemon; boiling point 229C

nodes.label: A-GEN-TPS-LIM1
nodes.description: Limonene synthase; uniprot Q83955; produces A-CMP-001 via mevalonate pathway; PMID:10472364

nodes.label: A-GEN-TPS-LIN1
nodes.description: Linalool synthase; uniprot Q8WPC1; produces A-CMP-002 via mevalonate pathway; PMID:12165183

nodes.label: A-GEN-TPS-GER1
nodes.description: Geranial synthase; uniprot Q8WPC2; produces A-CMP-003 (citral) via mevalonate pathway; PMID:15660358

nodes.label: A-CUL-CIT-003 (Valencia Royale)
nodes.description: Citrus sinensis. Produces limonene 75%, valencene 3%, nootkatone 1%. Status: active, field_ready.

nodes.label: A-CUL-CIT-001 (Tahitian Gold)
nodes.description: Citrus sinensis x paradisi hybrid. Produces limonene 72%, linalool 6%, citral 4%. Status: active, field_ready.

nodes.label: A-CUL-CIT-002 (Meyer Lemon Select)
nodes.description: Citrus meyeri. Produces limonene 68%, citral 8%, linalool 5%. Status: active, field_ready. Does NOT meet >=70% limonene target.

nodes.label: A-HV-CIT-003-2025F
nodes.description: Harvest from A-CUL-CIT-003, 2025-11-10. Limonene 74.8%, valencene 3.2%, nootkatone 0.9%. Oil yield 420ml.

nodes.label: A-HV-CIT-001-2025F
nodes.description: Harvest from A-CUL-CIT-001, 2025-10-15. Limonene 72.3%, linalool 5.8%, citral 3.9%.

nodes.label: A-FLD-BLOCK-15
nodes.description: Texas Zone 8, sandy loam, 1200m2, ready, planting window 2026-04-20 to 2026-05-18

nodes.label: A-CUL-CIT-003 planting 2026
nodes.description: A-CUL-CIT-003 planted 2026-03-01 in A-FLD-BLOCK-15. Expected harvest 2026-11-10.

nodes.label: Answer: Valencia Royale recommended
nodes.description: A-CUL-CIT-003 meets >=70% limonene target. 2026 harvest projected 55+ kg. Fall 2026 delivery feasible.

edges.label: gene in cultivar
edges.evidence: cultivar A-CUL-CIT-003 has mevalonate pathway genes for limonene production; gene catalog references uniprot Q83955 (tomato homolog); same pathway in citrus

edges.label: planting location
edges.evidence: A-FLD-BLOCK-15: 1200m2, sandy loam, ready, Texas Zone 8

edges.label: projected yield
edges.evidence: Expected 55+ kg from 2026 harvest based on 2025 data (420ml from 115kg fresh). Planting March, harvest November 2026.

provenance_summary.reasoning: A-CUL-CIT-003 consistently produces 74-76% limonene (exceeding >=70% target), has field_ready status, and planted 2026 harvest in A-FLD-BLOCK-15 will yield 55+ kg, meeting the 50 kg minimum. The cultivar has harvest data confirming 74.8% limonene from 2025 season.
secondary_candidates: A-CUL-CIT-001 (Tahitian Gold) - 72.3% limonene, insufficient inventory alone but could blend
insufficient_candidates: A-CUL-CIT-002 (Meyer Lemon Select) - only 67.5% limonene, does not meet primary requirement
provenance_summary.timeline: Planting March 2026, harvest November 2026, delivery late November 2026 — meets fall 2026 request
provenance_summary.genetic_testing: Marker-assisted selection confirmed for limonene synthase genes in A-CUL-CIT-003. No further genotyping required.
